prior_knowledge: Public scheme and target account; strategy-specific public corpus or model
oracle_access: Adaptive authorised login attempts up to budget q
observable_outputs: Declared protocol metadata and L1 Accept/Reject; separately test richer failure or timing leakage
success_condition: At least one accepted guess within q attempts
metrics: Success@q; expected/median guess rank; per-account success; rate-limited versus unbounded curves
evidence_method: Controlled online-oracle experiment plus replay/session tests
limitations: Rate limits are operational assumptions; results do not measure human-chosen-secret distributions

behaviour: Offline analyst; passive acquisition followed by arbitrary computation
prior_knowledge: Public scheme; attacker distributions; full database snapshot
compromise_views: Stored records and database metadata; no independent service keys unless co-stored
observable_outputs: Record fields; deterministic equality; local validation/inversion/linkage signals
protected_assets: Semantic content; accepted equivalents; resistance to offline validation; cross-service reuse
success_condition: Validate or rank guesses materially better than prior-only baseline; recover target attributes; or link records
metrics: Offline guesses/second and cost/guess; Success@q; ranking/distinguishing advantage; inversion metrics; linkage ROC/AUC
evidence_method: Construction analysis plus E9/E10/E11 attacks against exact snapshot
limitations: Database-only excludes separately protected keys; co-located keys move the case to A3

behaviour: Honest-but-curious or malicious as separately declared
prior_knowledge: Public scheme; attacker distributions; compromised service state and histories
oracle_access: Arbitrary offline computation and any query capability of compromised components
compromise_views: H1 full AS; H2 AS-only PS-only and collusion; H3 sub-threshold and threshold shares; H4 AS-only IKS query abuse key extraction and combined state
observable_outputs: All state/messages/keys available in the selected compromise row
protected_assets: Semantic credential; accepted equivalents; uncompromised component secrets; containment boundary
success_condition: Exceed the claimed leakage or validation capability without crossing its declared compromise threshold
metrics: Guess-validation cost and Success@q; recovered fields; transcript leakage; collusion outcome; policy-bypass rate
evidence_method: Data/key inventory; construction-specific proof or argument; malicious-deviation and failure/collusion tests
limitations: Total collusion/key capability receives no blanket protection promise; low semantic entropy remains

behaviour: Automated malicious client or offline guesser
prior_knowledge: Public prompt distributions plus frozen LLM VLM generator and frequency models
oracle_access: A1 online oracle or the exact A2/A3 offline view being studied
compromise_views: None for online case; named snapshot or compromise for offline case
observable_outputs: Same outputs as the parent A1 A2 or A3 case
protected_assets: Authentication and semantic secret against improved guess ordering
success_condition: Produce an accepted semantic neighbour within compute/query budget
metrics: Success@q and compute budget; marginal gain over random and frequency baselines; coverage and duplicates
evidence_method: Frozen attack manifests and paired strategy comparison on synthetic accounts
limitations: Public prompts are not authentication-secret choices; model capability and corpus bias bound inference

behaviour: Malicious online or offline guesser conditioned on side information
prior_knowledge: Exactly k named atoms or a frozen contextual-information stratum plus public scheme
oracle_access: A1 online oracle or named A2/A3 offline view
compromise_views: Parent threat view plus declared side information; never silently reveal the full target
protected_assets: Unknown semantic atoms and account authentication
success_condition: Accepted guess within q after conditioning on the declared partial information
metrics: Success@q by k and stratum; gain over no-side-information attack; uncertainty intervals
evidence_method: Stratified controlled experiment with atom selection and side-information provenance frozen
limitations: Does not estimate prevalence of real-world personal knowledge or user choices

behaviour: Offline analyst; honest-but-curious service; malicious service where declared
prior_knowledge: Public scheme ontology and auxiliary training data explicitly listed
oracle_access: No oracle unless the compromised view permits one
compromise_views: Stored representation helper data transcript score/count or keys from a named A2/A3 row
observable_outputs: Exact L0-L4 view for the candidate architecture
protected_assets: Objects attributes counts actions relations concept class prompt proxy and accepted equivalents
success_condition: Recover declared semantic fields or an accepted equivalent above prior and representation baselines
metrics: Per-atom precision/recall/F1; concept recovery; accepted-equivalent rate; calibrated advantage; attack cost
evidence_method: Versioned inversion attacks against plaintext embedding helper/token/transcript baselines and selected protocol views
limitations: Failure of tested attacks is not proof of non-invertibility; prompts need not be uniquely recoverable

behaviour: Two honest-but-curious services or analyst holding multiple snapshots
prior_knowledge: Public scheme and service identifiers; may know candidate account pairs only as declared
compromise_views: Two records/transcripts under distinct service domains; separate and colluding service views
observable_outputs: Deterministic tokens metadata lengths transcripts scores or recovered semantic signals
protected_assets: Reuse of the same semantic credential across services
success_condition: Distinguish same-secret pairs from different-secret hard-negative pairs above preregistered baseline
metrics: ROC/AUC; equal-error rate; distinguishing advantage with confidence interval; attack cost
evidence_method: Domain-separation analysis and balanced linkage game including semantic near-neighbour negatives
limitations: Account metadata and global identifiers must be removed from the game; total semantic disclosure trivially enables semantic linking

behaviour: Malicious authenticating client with adaptive crafted inputs
prior_knowledge: Public extractor matcher ontology threshold and optional surrogate models
oracle_access: A1-style decision oracle up to q; white-box local reference matcher where separately evaluated
compromise_views: No stolen victim client state; named server view only if combined with A2/A3
observable_outputs: Accept/Reject plus any exposed failure score or cardinality
protected_assets: Authentication integrity and intended semantic distinction
success_condition: Find an input judged substantially different by frozen ground truth yet accepted; or exploit malformed/version input to change the decision
metrics: Success@q; semantic edit distance/category; transfer rate; query/compute cost; protocol/reference disagreement
evidence_method: Targeted semantic-neighbour search adversarial input generation boundary tests and malformed/version tests
limitations: Empirical collision resistance is budget/model qualified and is not a cryptographic collision-resistance claim
